snippet.title: Antichrist and Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers - World Premiere Trailer | The Horror Game Awards 2026
snippet.description:
"Two terrifying mysteries. Two chilling survival horror experiences inspired by real events.

Antichrist takes you to an abandoned village in Pakistan, where journalist Tommy Aseer investigates a disturbing mystery inspired by an alleged incident from 2006. Uncover sinister secrets, solve puzzles, and fight to survive.

Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers takes you to the remote Flannan Isles in Scotland, where three lighthouse keepers mysteriously vanished in 1900. Explore the desolate island, uncover disturbing clues, and discover the truth behind one of maritime history's greatest mysteries.

Some secrets are better left buried. Will you dare to uncover them?

WISHLIST NOW

🔴 Antichrist
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3902550/Antichrist/
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/ja-jp/concept/10017466

🌊 Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3871570/
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/ja-jp/concept/10016718

#AntichristGame #EileanMor #SurvivalHorror #HorrorGame #SerafiniProductions"---
Originally aired during The Horror Game Awards 2026 on Friday 20 November 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
